chunks: And from him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah, who said:

I asked him about the muhrim who dies, and he said: “He is given ghusl and shrouded in all the garments, and his face is covered. It is done with him as is done with the non-muhrim, except that perfume is not applied to him.”

key_terms.الْمُحِلِّ: the one not in the state of ihram
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.يُغَسَّلُ: is given ghusl (ritual washing of the deceased)

ai.seo_question: How should a muhrim who dies be washed and shrouded according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim who dies while in the state of ihram. It states that he is treated in burial like one who is not in ihram in washing, shrouding, and covering, except that perfume is not to be applied to him.
